ITEM 1 | Grey-brown sliced meat pieces, roughly 8 to 10 pieces, some with pinkish-red centers and browned exterior, moist-looking with slight sheen, firm shape, elongated strips about 5 to 7 cm long and 1.5 to 2 cm wide, piled in a cluster on the left side of the plate, with a small green herb fragment tucked among them | 150
ITEM 2 | Two triangular wedges of flatbread-style crust, golden tan with browned edges, topped with red-orange tomato sauce, melted pale cheese with light browning, and round dark-red pepperoni-style slices, each wedge about 10 to 12 cm along the outer edge, sitting on the right side of the plate | 160
ITEM 3 | Dark brown rectangular block with a glossy, slightly moist surface and fine crumbly texture, about 4 by 3 cm and 2 cm tall, sitting alone at the upper right edge of the plate, no visible sauce around it | 40
